title: ProductInteroperability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Interoperability viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for integration governance: API style, data format standards, versioning, schema compliance. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying integration state. Source framework: TOGAF (Application Architecture, Integration Architecture) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Interoperability — Co-existence, Compatibility).

schemaRegistryCompliant.description: Whether schemas are published to and validated against a schema registry.
